GMA Series                                                                     WEB

 1       Allows for high density mounting.                                                                                                                                                         GR7

Excessive ultrasonic oscillation during cleaning can cause
the PCBs to resonate, resulting in cracked chips or broken                                                                                                                                                          LLL
solder joints. Before starting your production process, test
your cleaning equipment/process to insure it does not
degrade the capacitors.                                                                                                                                                                                             LLA

 GR3        8. Assembly
            1. Handling
               If a board mounted with capacitors is held with one hand,
 GRJ           the board may bend. Firmly hold the edges of the board
               with both hands when handling.
               If a board mounted with capacitors is dropped, cracks
 GR4
               may occur in the capacitors.
               Do not use dropped boards, as there is a possibility that
               the quality of the capacitors may be impaired.
 GR7
            2. Attachment of Other Components
               2-1. Mounting of Other Components
 GJM                 Pay attention to the following items, when mounting
                     other components on the back side of the board
                     after capacitors have been mounted on the opposite
 GQM
                                                                                                                                                                                             Suction Nozzle
                     side.
                     When the bottom dead point of the suction nozzle is
                     set too low, board deflection stress may be applied
 GA2
                     to the capacitors on the back side (bottom side), and
                     cracks may occur in the capacitors.
GA3
GB                   · After the board is straightened, set the bottom
                       dead point of the nozzle on the upper surface of the
GA3
                       board.
GD                   · Periodically check and adjust the bottom dead point.
               2-2. Inserting Components with Leads into Boards
GA3                  When inserting components (transformers, IC, etc.)
GF
                     into boards, bending the board may cause cracks in                                                                                          Component with Leads
                     the capacitors or cracks in the solder.
                     Pay attention to the following.
 LLL
                     · Increase the size of the holes to insert the leads, to
                       reduce the stress on the board during insertion.
 LLA                 · Fix the board with support pins or a dedicated jig
                       before insertion.
                     · Support below the board so that the board does not
 LLM                   bend. When using support pins on the board,
                       periodically confirm that there is no difference in
                       the height of each support pin.
 LLR
               2-3. Attaching/Removing Sockets and/or Connectors
                     Insertion and removal of sockets and connectors,
                     etc., might cause the board to bend. Please insure
 NFM
                                                                                                                                                                                             Socket
                     that the board does not warp during insertion and
                     removal of sockets and connectors, etc., or the
 KRM                 bending may damage mounted components on the
                     board.
               2-4. Tightening Screws
 KR3                 The board may be bent, when tightening screws, etc.
                     during the attachment of the board to a shield or                                                                                                                                  Screwdriver

                     chassis.
 GMA
                     Pay attention to the following items before
                     performing the work.
 GMD
                     · Plan the work to prevent the board from bending.
                     · Use a torque screwdriver, to prevent
                       over-tightening of the screws.

GA3                                                                                                                           When the load is constant, the following relationship can be established.
GB                                                                                                                            · As the distance between the supporting points (L) increases,
                                                                                                                                the amount of strain also increases.
                                                                                                                                →Reduce the distance between the supporting points.
                                                                                                                              · As the elastic modulus (E) decreases, the amount of strain increases.
GA3                                                                                                                             →Increase the elastic modulus.
GD                                                                                                                            · As the board width (w) decreases, the amount of strain increases.
                                                                                                                                →Increase the width of the board.
                                                                                                                              · As the board thickness (h) decreases, the amount of strain increases.
GA3                                                                                                                             →Increase the thickness of the board.
GF                                                                                                                              Since the board thickness is squared, the effect on the amount of strain
                                                                                                                                becomes even greater.

               Web page Introduction



                         1                                            2                                            3


                 Search by Part Number
               1 http://psearch.en.murata.com/capacitor/partnumber/

                                                                                                                             You can search for capacitors by specifying the
                                                                                                                             alphanumeric characters in the part number.
                                                                                                                             The packing codes shown contain the substitute
                                                                                                                             character "#". If you enter the official packing
                                                                                                                             code, part numbers that contain that packing
                                                                                                                             code will be matched.




                 Search by Specifications
               2 http://psearch.en.murata.com/capacitor/spec/smd/

                                                                                                                             You can search for SMD, lead type, or screw
                                                                                                                             termination type capacitors by indicating
                                                                                                                             speciﬁcations such as application, capacitance,
                                                                                                                             rated voltage, or temperature characteristics.

                                                                                                                             You can narrow your search by entering values
                                                                                                                             of ranges, and by specifying product
                                                                                                                             characteristics.

                                                                                                                             The items for narrowing searches are linked, so
                                                                                                                             specifying one condition causes selectable
                                                                                                                             options for the other items to allow input only of
                                                                                                                             conditions that match the relevant part
                                                                                                                             numbers.
